originalObservations: Recognizable compact yellow submarine with oval hull, circular blue porthole, paired red lateral pods, golden lips/fins, rear propeller and small nose light.

Original render has very bright near-yellow top facets and comparatively flat, coarse transitions; hull, fins and pods merge into large unarticulated areas. The cyan glint reads as a small spot rather than glass depth.
Warm soft style reference uses rounded/beveled volumes, broad clean value changes, warm edge light and clearly separated materials, with restrained detail that remains legible.
targetObservations: Target improves the broad hull curvature, substantial constructed porthole rim, thick pod bands, inset panel divisions and rounded nose-light housing. These are useful native design directions.
Target silver fasteners and dark desaturated metal accents separate yellow/red/glass, with a large blue window carrying crisp soft-edged reflections.

Target is a 1024x1536 aesthetic exploration with changed framing/scale and cannot define registered pixel bounds. Its front orientation does not establish unseen rear/side design or native socket positions.
Density of rivets and panel lines should be judged at logical size; exact rivet count and imagegen highlight positions are not requirements. Avoid reproducing yellow halos/noise.
